text: The Nominating Panel – Property Standards Committee will select candidates for interview for appointment to the Property Standards Committee. Following interviews, the Nominating Panel will recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.

The Nominating Panel - Property Standards Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Property Standards Committee: Candidate PSC2-82 Candidate PSC2-88 Candidate PSC2-131 Candidate PSC2-134 Candidate PSC2-150 Candidate PSC2-151 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (September 22, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Property Standards Committee.
